articles.summary: MIAMI, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- MIRA Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: MIRA) ("MIRA" or the "Company") , a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company developing novel oral small-molecule therapeutics, today announced positive results from completed 7-day dose-range finding toxicology and toxicokinetic studies of MIRA-55 in rats and dogs.
